attachmentControls.label: open file picker
attachmentControls.launcherAction: Keep the picker disabled and do not ask the host for file handles.
attachmentControls.userAction: Choose files only after a reviewed local file-input boundary exists.

attachmentControls.label: read file metadata
attachmentControls.launcherAction: Refuse metadata reads because file input has not been reviewed.
attachmentControls.userAction: Read file metadata only after explicit consent, filtering, and redaction policy exists.

attachmentControls.label: read file content
attachmentControls.launcherAction: Refuse content reads because no attachment ingestion boundary exists.
attachmentControls.userAction: Read attachment content only after local parsing and redaction rules are reviewed.

attachmentControls.label: import attachment
attachmentControls.launcherAction: Keep import disabled and do not copy, parse, or index any file.
attachmentControls.userAction: Import only after type limits, size limits, redaction, and persistence review.

attachmentControls.label: upload attachment
attachmentControls.launcherAction: Do not upload attachment data or call cloud/provider endpoints.
attachmentControls.userAction: Upload remains unavailable for the local-only chat surface.

attachmentControls.label: preview attachment
attachmentControls.launcherAction: Keep preview disabled because no attachment bytes may be read.
attachmentControls.userAction: Preview only after file read, rendering, and redaction boundaries exist.

attachmentControls.label: persist attachment
attachmentControls.launcherAction: Refuse attachment persistence because no storage boundary exists.
attachmentControls.userAction: Persist only after a reviewed local store and deletion policy exists.

attachmentInputs.label: local file
attachmentInputs.summary: Local file attachments need a reviewed picker, metadata, content, redaction, and persistence boundary.

attachmentInputs.label: local directory
attachmentInputs.summary: Directory attachments remain out of scope until recursive discovery and redaction rules are reviewed.

attachmentInputs.label: clipboard payload
attachmentInputs.summary: Clipboard-backed attachments remain disabled because no clipboard read boundary exists.

attachmentInputs.label: generated artifact
attachmentInputs.summary: Generated artifacts are not read or attached until an artifact input boundary is reviewed.

attachmentInputs.label: transcript export
attachmentInputs.summary: Transcript export as an attachment remains disabled until storage and redaction policy exists.

attachmentPolicy.contentPolicy: attachment policy metadata only; no file names, paths, bytes, previews, manifests, transcript text, prompt text, or response text are included
attachmentPolicy.sourcePolicy: checked fixture only; no file picker, path, metadata, content, clipboard, transcript, artifact, model path, or runtime log is read

blockedReasons.summary: Attachment ingestion requires separate local parser, redaction, and storage review.
No reviewed file-picker or explicit user-selection boundary exists.
No reviewed file metadata read boundary exists.
No reviewed file content read, parser, size-limit, or redaction boundary exists.
No import, copy, export, or attachment manifest boundary is configured.
Attachment persistence needs explicit local store, retention, deletion, and rollback policy.
The standalone chat surface keeps upload and cloud/provider attachment handoff disabled.
No clipboard-read boundary exists for attachment payloads.

handoffRefs.summary: Composer attach controls remain disabled and do not read files.
Shortcut-map attach binding remains disabled and dispatch-free.
Local-only policy keeps cloud/provider fallback disabled.
Transcript export and persistence remain disabled.

limitations: Data-only chat attachment-policy fixture; no real attachment input boundary is configured or read.

Attachment controls remain disabled or blocked; no file picker opens and no file name, path, metadata, bytes, preview, transcript, prompt, response, model path, runtime log, private path, secret, or token content is included.
No local file, directory, clipboard payload, generated artifact, transcript export, or attachment manifest is read, imported, uploaded, copied, parsed, indexed, persisted, deleted, or written.
No model load, runtime execution, provider call, network call, pccx-lab invocation, systemverilog-ide invocation, or KV260 hardware access is performed.
This is not a release, tag, compatibility commitment, MCP, LSP, IDE, marketplace, telemetry, runtime, model, parser, file-input, or storage implementation.
